projects_inbox_protected.name: projects_inbox_protected
projects_inbox_protected.value: "projects"."kind" <> 'inbox' or ("projects"."archived_at" is null and "projects"."deleted_at" is null)

tasks_due_date_idx.name: tasks_due_date_idx
tasks_due_date_idx.where: "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."status" <> 'done' and "tasks"."archived_at" is null

tasks_due_at_idx.name: tasks_due_at_idx
tasks_due_at_idx.where: "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."due_at" is not null and "tasks"."status" <> 'done'

tasks_start_before_due.name: tasks_start_before_due
tasks_start_before_due.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."due_date" is null or "tasks"."start_date" <= "tasks"."due_date"

tasks_due_time_complete.name: tasks_due_time_complete
tasks_due_time_complete.value: "tasks"."due_time" is null or ("tasks"."due_date" is not null and "tasks"."timezone" is not null and "tasks"."due_at" is not null)

tasks_recurrence_valid.name: tasks_recurrence_valid
tasks_recurrence_valid.value: "tasks"."recurrence_rule" is null or ("tasks"."due_date" is not null and "tasks"."parent_task_id" is null and "tasks"."recurrence_mode" in ('fixed_schedule','after_completion') and "tasks"."recurrence_series_id" is not null and "tasks"."recurrence_anchor" is not null and "tasks"."recurrence_index" >= 1)

reminders_offset.name: reminders_offset
reminders_offset.value: ("reminders"."kind" = 'relative') = ("reminders"."offset_minutes" is not null) and ("reminders"."offset_minutes" is null or "reminders"."offset_minutes" >= 0)
